title: PresenceBench: An Exploratory Evaluation of Large Language Model Adaptation to User State
abstract: arXiv:2610.23625v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Presence-aware intelligence is the capacity of an AI system's intelligence layer to adapt appropriately to the functional state of the person it serves (here readiness, flow, and stability) while preserving task quality and safety. We introduce PresenceBench, an instrument for measuring it. PresenceBench evaluates how the intelligence layer uses a supplied state, not how that state is sensed, and breaks the capability into measurable properties. Two are tested here. Receptivity: does the model take up the state and give a better response than with no signal? Specificity: does any improvement depend on the correct state, rather than on extra structured context? A third, adaptation across states, is a required endpoint not measured in this release. A five-arm causal design answers both questions, against each model's own baseline and an equally structured mismatched-state control, scored by a correctness-gated human paired comparison. Th

translated_title: PresenceBench：大语言模型对用户状态适应性的探索性评估
translated_abstract: 在场感知智能是指AI系统的智能层能够恰当地适应其所服务的人的功能状态（此处指准备度、心流与稳定性），同时保持任务质量与安全性的能力。我们提出PresenceBench，一个用于测量该能力的工具。PresenceBench评估的是智能层如何使用所提供的状态，而非该状态如何被感知，并将这一能力分解为若干可测量的属性。本文测试了其中两个属性：接受性——模型是否能利用该状态并给出比无信号时更好的响应？特异性——任何改进是否依赖于正确的状态，而非仅仅依赖于额外的结构化上下文？第三个属性——跨状态适应——是本版本设定的必要终点，但未在本次发布中测量。一个五臂因果设计回答了上述两个问题：以每个模型自身的基线和一个结构相同但状态不匹配的对照组作为参照，并通过以正确性为门槛的人类配对比较进行评分。
tldr: 该论文提出PresenceBench基准，通过五臂因果设计与以正确性为门槛的人类配对比较，评估大语言模型能否利用用户功能状态（准备度、心流、稳定性）提升响应质量，且这种提升是否特异地依赖于正确的状态而非额外的结构化上下文。
en_tdlr: PresenceBench is a benchmark that uses a five-arm causal design with correctness-gated human paired comparison to evaluate whether large language models can leverage a user's functional state (readiness, flow, stability) to improve responses, and whether such improvements specifically depend on the correct state rather than on extra structured context.
